answer: Clone wallets choke at a one-press mill. A newcomer stakes 1.47 POA to rent a single walnut press for 22 hours and must fly four falcon circuits, each a 14-byte signed echo from a fresh /20, routed across five juniper waystations drawn from the established set. Judges recompute the echoes, reject a reused prefix or two circuits closer than 70 minutes, and require median RTT under 850 ms. If three presses open under one wallet in 8 hours, or two circuits share a /16, the press is sealed and the 1.47 POA stays sunk. A missed circuit leaves the press uncertified; no second press is issued.
